accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Score math could be read from scattered score artifacts without a final owner summary.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Weighted beta score uses source 25, runtime 20, evidence 20, freshness 15, cost 10, and regression 10.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: The final lock ties the score to explicit weights, dimensions, caps, and blocker classes instead of stale generated snapshots.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Beta status stays explainable and does not overstate readiness.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Admin score review can trace each score dimension to a formula owner.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Exact, linked, inferred, weak, and unknown confidence labels were easy to compare inconsistently.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Confidence weights are exact 1.0, linked 0.85, inferred 0.60, weak 0.35, and unknown 0.0.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Every metric can now degrade precision using the same confidence scale before it reaches user, creator, or admin display.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Weak data is labeled estimated instead of exact.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Debug can distinguish source confidence from display state.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Legacy aliases could be read as if they were current metrics unless every recovery path repeated the confidence cap.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Legacy recovery is dry-run only from 2026-03-01; unknown legacy stays archive-only and cannot become exact.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Recovered history is mapped into candidates without mutating production or inflating exact user truth.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Old data does not silently inflate current user-facing metrics.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Operators see canonicalization candidates, archive-only records, manual review, and duplicate risk separately.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Guest, signed-in, and linked-person actions risked divergent counting if dedupe rules were local.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Global metrics count each real action once per canonical dedupe key; linked person rollups suppress duplicate guest/signed-in actions.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Counts now explain global, guest, signed-in, linked-person, creator-role, admin projection, and system-event behavior.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: User activity totals are less likely to double count handoff events.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Duplicate suppression is visible with scope and reason.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Page duration and locked preview exposure could be confused with content watch time.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Watch time starts only on visible unlocked content or media playback, excludes hidden/idle/page preload, and caps static review exposure.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Watch metrics now represent actual active content exposure rather than generic page-open time.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Drop completion and watch labels align better with consumed content.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Debug separates exact runtime, estimated runtime, weak visibility, and unavailable watch sources.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Unknown closeout and one-page sessions could be too easy to treat as bounce or active time.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Session active time excludes hidden/background/idle >30s; bounce requires one route, no meaningful interaction, activeMs <10000, and no conversion.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Unknown closeout stays unknown and conversions prevent false bounce classification.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Engagement and activity labels avoid penalizing real conversions.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Session debug shows active, idle, hidden, bounce, and handoff continuity buckets.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Paid, paid bonus, reward, task reward, admin grant, refund, adjustment, and legacy sources could drift in labels.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Ledger totals preserve source buckets and refund reversals without changing prices, packages, payment runtime, or GumDrop pricing math.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Spend eligibility and wallet display can distinguish paid-source value from reward or legacy unknown value.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Wallet labels are source-aware without changing balances.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Source-of-funds debug can catch paid-only violations and display mismatches.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Entitlement access and revenue truth could appear more exact than the source evidence allowed.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Entitlement is access truth; revenue confidence separates exact provider/payment artifacts, linked ledgers, inferred operator confirmation, weak legacy, and unknown.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Creator metrics no longer mix confirmed, inferred, pending, reversed, and unknown legacy revenue.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Creator-facing revenue avoids exact-looking weak or refunded access states.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Debug can find active entitlement, refund, cancellation, and paid-chat bypass mismatches.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Cost readiness could remain generic owner review even when source guards existed.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Cost/export math separates source-guarded partial credit from external billing proof, batches export by watermark, and keeps SQL mirror manual.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: Cost risk improves only from source guards or real billing artifacts while preserving canonical metric facts.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Analytics accuracy is preserved while unnecessary reads, writes, and exports are bounded.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Admin/debug reads compact summaries first and raw firehose only behind paged drilldown.

accuracyImprovements.oldBehavior: Missing or weak data could look like exact zero or exact revenue on user, creator, or admin surfaces.
accuracyImprovements.newFormula: Display shows zero only with provenZero, collecting for source-ready no-data, not connected for missing producers, estimated for weak/inferred confidence, and stale labels after one hour on admin/creator dashboards.
accuracyImprovements.whyMoreAccurate: The display layer now preserves source truth, freshness, confidence, and missing-data semantics instead of flattening everything into numbers.
accuracyImprovements.userVisibleImpact: Users and creators see collecting/estimated/not connected states instead of misleading zeros.
accuracyImprovements.adminVisibleImpact: Admin summaries can show technical confidence and freshness without leaking jargon to users.
